name: Indian Journal of School Research and Innovation
school: ACRI School of Education & Human Development (SEHD)
scope:
The Indian Journal of School Research and Innovation (IJSRI) is a national, open-access, peer-reviewed journal that publishes original research by school students in India up to 18 years of age, from Classes 6 to 12 (or equivalent) under any board: CBSE, CISCE, state boards, IB, Cambridge and NIOS.

IJSRI aims to build a research culture in Indian schools by giving young researchers a rigorous but supportive route to publication. Every submission is mentored by a teacher or supervisor and reviewed by qualified academics, who give constructive feedback that helps students learn the craft of research.

The journal is multidisciplinary. It welcomes empirical studies, experiments, surveys, field projects, literature reviews, data analyses, case studies and innovation projects across the sciences, mathematics, technology, social sciences, humanities, commerce and the arts. Work must be the student's own, ethically conducted and clearly reported. Articles are published continuously on acceptance and gathered into one volume each year.
